summary: Master the art of risk identification and assessment in credit management. Join our expert-led training course to safeguard your financial decisions today.
lede: Risk Identification and Assessment in Credit Management equips professionals to identify, categorize, and evaluate credit risks before they escalate into defaults. You will learn to use risk matrices, probability-impact analysis, and quantitative and qualitative methods to assess borrower reliability and prioritize exposures. The course connects risk management theory with practical credit decisions, helping you document assessments and align them with internal and external credit standards. Build a more proactive approach to balancing profitability, protection, and performance across credit portfolios, loan approvals, and financial oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is specifically tailored for professionals actively engaged in credit risk management and lending operations. It caters to those who must navigate the complexities of credit exposures and maintain robust risk oversight.
modules: Biases and Human Factors in Risk Judgment
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of credit management principles and some experience in financial analysis or lending operations.
